description: This file contains utility functions for arithmetic operations, including safe addition, subtraction, multiplication with overflow checks, binomial coefficients, factorials, GCD, LCM, power functions, Stirling numbers, and power-of-two checks, tailored for the Apache Commons Math library.

classes.name: ArithmeticUtils
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for precise arithmetic operations with overflow checking, combinatorial calculations, and number theory functions, used within the Apache Commons Math library.

methods.name: addAndCheck
methods.description: Adds two integers with overflow checking, throws exception if overflow occurs.

methods.name: addAndCheck
methods.description: Adds two long integers with overflow checking, throws exception if overflow occurs.

methods.name: binomialCoefficient
methods.description: Calculates the binomial coefficient (n choose k) as a long, with preconditions on inputs (use of deprecated method using CombinatoricsUtils).

methods.name: binomialCoefficientDouble
methods.description: Calculates the binomial coefficient as a double.

methods.name: binomialCoefficientLog
methods.description: Calculates the natural logarithm of the binomial coefficient.

methods.name: factorial
methods.description: Calculates n! as a long.

methods.name: factorialDouble
methods.description: Calculates n! as a double.

methods.name: factorialLog
methods.description: Calculates the natural logarithm of n!

methods.name: gcd
methods.description: Computes the greatest common divisor of two integers, with overflow checks.

methods.name: gcd
methods.description: Computes the greatest common divisor of two longs, using the binary gcd algorithm.

methods.name: lcm
methods.description: Calculates the least common multiple of two integers.

methods.name: lcm
methods.description: Calculates the least common multiple of two longs.

methods.name: mulAndCheck
methods.description: Multiplies two integers with overflow checking.

methods.name: mulAndCheck
methods.description: Multiplies two longs with overflow checking.

methods.name: subAndCheck
methods.description: Subtracts two integers with overflow checking.

methods.name: subAndCheck
methods.description: Subtracts two longs with overflow checking.

methods.name: pow
methods.description: Raises an integer to a non-negative integer power, with overflow check.

methods.name: pow
methods.description: Raises an integer to a long power, deprecated.

methods.name: pow
methods.description: Raises a long to a non-negative integer power, with overflow check.

methods.name: pow
methods.description: Raises a long to a long power, deprecated.

methods.name: pow
methods.description: Raises a BigInteger to a non-negative integer power.

methods.name: pow
methods.description: Raises a BigInteger to a long power.

methods.name: pow
methods.description: Raises a BigInteger to a BigInteger power.

methods.name: stirlingS2
methods.description: Calculates the Stirling number of the second kind.

methods.name: isPowerOfTwo
methods.description: Checks whether a long value is a power of two.
